title: Stabilize control-plane reconciliation for PR state and agent queue pickup
specification:
# PRD: Stabilize control-plane reconciliation for PR state and agent queue pickup

Priority: high

## Problem
The control plane shows contradictory repository state: PR #29 is marked open remotely but inferred merged locally, and the implementation agent shows queued work while runtime reports idle with no queued tasks. This makes the UI misleading and may prevent or delay newly queued work from starting.

## Goal
Make control-plane state authoritative and self-consistent so queued work is picked up reliably and PR status reflects canonical remote truth when available.

## Requirements
- Prefer canonical remote pull request state over inferred terminal task state when the two disagree, and surface inference only as secondary diagnostic context.
- Reconcile implementation queue state with runtime worker state so queued tasks are discoverable and trigger worker attachment consistently.
- Ensure agent status snapshots cannot report `idle/no queued tasks` while tracked queue state for that same agent still contains queued work unless an explicit error state is shown.
- Expose a clear degraded/error state when GitHub validation fails or when scheduler/worker reconciliation is stale.
- Preserve existing branch/deploy contract and tracked queue/PRD file formats.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A PR that is still open on GitHub is shown as open in the control plane even if linked tasks are terminal, with any drift clearly labeled as diagnostic detail only.
- When a new implementation task or PRD is queued, the responsible agent either starts within the expected polling window or the UI shows an explicit pickup error instead of idle/no-work messaging.
- No status snapshot can simultaneously show queued implementation work and `detail: no queued tasks` for the same agent without an explicit reconciliation error code.
- Tests cover stale PR reconciliation, queued-task pickup, and idle-vs-queued status rendering.

## Verification
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run targeted unit tests for control-plane status and reconciliation logic, especially `tests/unit/control-plane-*.test.ts` and sync/queue tests relevant to agent status reconstruction.
- Run smoke coverage for control-plane/bridge behavior if the change crosses scheduler or worker attach flow, including `tests/smoke/control-plane.test.ts`.

tasks.title: Make remote GitHub PR state authoritative in control-plane reconciliation
tasks.description: Update the control-plane and sync reconciliation paths so pull request status shown in snapshots and UI prefers canonical remote GitHub state when validation succeeds, even when linked local task or branch inference suggests a terminal state. Keep inferred local terminal conclusions available only as secondary diagnostic context, and surface an explicit degraded or validation-error state when GitHub truth cannot be confirmed. Likely touch points include PR reconstruction and status shaping under `src/sync/`, `src/autonomy-v2/control-plane/`, and any control-plane server rendering or API code under `src/server/control-plane/` that currently promotes inferred merged state ahead of remote PR truth.
acceptance: When GitHub validation fails, the control plane does not silently fall back to a misleading terminal PR state; it instead exposes a clear degraded or validation-error status while preserving existing tracked PRD and queue file formats.

Targeted tests are added or updated for stale PR reconciliation and degraded GitHub validation behavior, including relevant `tests/unit/control-plane-*.test.ts` coverage and any sync-focused unit tests that reconstruct PR status.
Verification for this task includes `npm run typecheck` and the focused unit tests covering PR reconciliation and status rendering.

tasks.title: Reconcile queued implementation work with runtime worker status and pickup flow
tasks.description: Update queue reconstruction, scheduler or worker-attach reconciliation, and control-plane status rendering so tracked queued implementation work is discoverable by the responsible lane and cannot be presented simultaneously with `idle` or `detail: no queued tasks` unless an explicit reconciliation error or stale-worker condition is shown. Preserve the existing tracked queue and PRD file formats while making new queued implementation work either start within the expected polling window or surface an actionable pickup error in the control plane. Likely touch points include queue or lane state reconstruction under `src/sync/`, runtime snapshot generation under `src/autonomy-v2/control-plane/`, scheduler or runner behavior under `src/autonomy-v2/commands/` or `src/autonomy-v2/runner/`, and control-plane server or UI paths under `src/server/control-plane/` that render agent status details.
acceptance: If tracked queue state for `architecture-agent` contains queued work, status snapshots and rendered control-plane details do not report `idle` with `detail: no queued tasks` unless they also include an explicit reconciliation or stale-worker error code explaining the mismatch.

When a new implementation task or PRD is queued for the responsible lane, the scheduler or worker attach path picks it up within the expected polling window, or the control plane surfaces a clear pickup error instead of idle or no-work messaging.
Targeted tests are added or updated for queued-task pickup and idle-vs-queued status rendering, including relevant sync or queue unit tests and `tests/unit/control-plane-*.test.ts` coverage.
If the scheduler or worker attach flow is touched, verification also includes `tests/smoke/control-plane.test.ts` alongside `npm run typecheck` and the focused unit tests.
